items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I didn't play with him too long... I played, four months time... I played over ten jobs.

ctx.x: I said, well, I sit in and on a fella's place.

He said, well, you the one I'm talking about. He said, I'd like to hire you for Saturday night. I said, well, I have a job for Saturday night. So he said, well, how about Sunday night? Well, I said, well, yeah, that'd be all right. So he said, well, I'll tell you, you'll be at the economy hall for quarter to eight. I said, okay. Well, I had heard about Randy's band. It was a nice band he had. And I had heard his band too. You see? And I couldn't hardly realize he'd come to hire me to play in his band even one…
Yeah, he's having to worry about it.
